comment: Expected chip/OS/Python baseline used ONLY as a drift gate by
tools/gen_cann_release.py. The generated matrix itself is always
cloned from the previous release entries in build_cann_arg.json and
build_manylinux_arg.json (single source of truth); this file merely
detects when those entries drift away from what maintainers expect
(new chip series, new base image, accidental hotfix residue).
Update the sets here when the intended baseline changes; combos in a
new release outside these sets abort the run for human review.
Order is irrelevant; tags are cloned in the order found in the arg
